other_face_facts: Para 1 / 47: $40 million Empire-group scheme / fraudulently received May 2020-January 2022.
ThinkTechAct/Mind Foundry claimed more than 25,000 children a day (paras 22, 37); more than two dozen sites.
Mukhtar Shariff alleged up to 3,500 children a day at a Bloomington site (para 27).
Aimee Bock is named as FOF founder/ED (paras 10-14, 72-74) but is not a defendant in this instrument.
Hadith Yusuf Ahmed and Individual I.M. are named as FOF employees who solicited/received kickbacks; not caption defendants.
Individual J.S. is a Sponsor A employee/board member who created The Free Minded Institute; not a caption defendant.
Count 13 and Counts 14-19 name only Abdiaziz Farah, Said Farah, and/or Mukhtar Shariff (per row).
Count 43 is Abdiaziz Farah only and is outside forfeiture Counts 1-42.
Count 17 table date August 13 vs para 146 August 17 for the $10,000 Empire Enterprises to J.S. check.
Search warrants executed on or about January 20, 2022 (para 141) at Empire Cuisine and Market, ThinkTechAct, and Said Farah's residence.
This is Feeding Our Future / Empire family, not HSS.
